_about: Round 948 source record for Missing Nine (src/lib/missingNine.ts). One row per sheet: the game, the two box scores it was read from (two different hosts, never a wiki), the nine starters in batting order exactly as both boxes agree, and every blank with its nationality (birthplace as both player pages give it) and its fact as checked. scripts/simMissingNineSources.mjs holds the data file to this record. Box reads: 2026-10-02 (new sheets, 2016 G7) and 2026-10-03 (2001, 1988, 1986, 2013); player pages read 2026-10-03 on baseball-reference.com/players and baseball-almanac.com/players. Starters are the un-indented almanac batting rows and the baseball-reference Starting Lineups table, matched by player id; positions are the starting position (almanac lists every position played, the first one is the start).

townDisagreements: Reggie Jackson: baseball-reference Abington, PA; baseball-almanac Wyncote, Pennsylvania. Both USA.
Sandy Amoros: baseball-reference Matanzas, Cuba; baseball-almanac Havana, Cuba. Both Cuba.
Dave Parker: baseball-reference Grenada, MS; baseball-almanac Calhoun, Mississippi. Both USA.
Yu Darvish: baseball-reference Habikino, Osaka; baseball-almanac Osaka. Both Japan.
nameDisagreements: Nori Aoki: baseball-reference bills him Nori Aoki, baseball-almanac Norichika Aoki. The sheet uses Nori Aoki, the name he played under; the surname is what the game checks.

sheets.game: 2016 World Series Game 7, 2016-11-02, Progressive Field: Cubs 8, Indians 7 (10 inn)

sources.role: recap for the inning by inning facts

blanks.name: Kyle Schwarber
blanks.fact: Had three hits as the DH before Albert Almora Jr. ran for him in the 10th and scored the go-ahead run.
blanks.checked: almanac 5-0-3-0 and Almora Jr. pr,dh scoring a run; bref subs: Almora pinch runs for Schwarber, top 10th, and pbp: Zobrist double at 6-6, Almora scores; SABR: Almora ran for Schwarber and scored on the Zobrist double. Old fact (knee ligaments, seven months) dropped: SABR says leg ligaments and almost seven months, no second host.

blanks.name: Willson Contreras
blanks.fact: Started behind the plate, David Ross (who homered) only entered in the 5th with Jon Lester.
blanks.checked: bref subs bottom 5th: Lester replaces Hendricks, Ross replaces Contreras; SABR: along with Lester came David Ross, fifth inning; Ross HR 6th off Miller on both boxes.

blanks.name: Ben Zobrist
blanks.fact: His 10th-inning double off Bryan Shaw broke the 6-6 tie.
blanks.checked: both boxes: 2B off Shaw; bref pbp top 10th at 6-6, Almora scores; SABR same. Old 'Series MVP' dropped: not in either box.

sheets.game: 2016 World Series Game 7, 2016-11-02, Progressive Field: Cubs 8, Indians 7 (10 inn)

sources.role: recap for the inning by inning facts

blanks.name: Rajai Davis
blanks.fact: His two-run, two-out homer off Aroldis Chapman in the 8th tied Game 7 at 6-6.
blanks.checked: both boxes: HR 8th off Chapman, 1 on, 2 out; bref pbp bottom 8th at 4-6; SABR: two-run, game-tying home run in the eighth.

blanks.name: Roberto Perez
blanks.fact: Batted ninth and caught the start, Yan Gomes only entered late.
blanks.checked: both boxes: Perez c 9th, Gomes c indented sub; bref subs: Gomes in at catcher top 8th after Naquin ran for Perez.

blanks.name: Coco Crisp
blanks.fact: Doubled and scored Cleveland's first run; Michael Martinez later replaced him in the field.
blanks.checked: both boxes: 2B off Hendricks, Martinez indented sub; bref pbp bottom 3rd: Crisp double, Santana single, Crisp scores; SABR: Santana singled in Crisp, who had reached on a double. DISAGREEMENT: SABR puts Martinez's entry in the eighth, bref pbp in the top of the 9th, so the old 'in the 8th' is dropped and no inning is claimed.

sheets.game: 1988 World Series Game 1, 1988-10-15, Dodger Stadium: Dodgers 5, Athletics 4

blanks.checked: both boxes: Hatcher lf starter, HR 1st off Stewart, 1 on; Gibson ph only, HR 9th.

blanks.name: Franklin Stubbs

sheets.game: 1986 World Series Game 6, 1986-10-25, Shea Stadium: Mets 6, Red Sox 5 (10 inn)

sources.role: recap for the inning by inning facts

blanks.name: Roger Clemens
blanks.fact: Started and threw seven innings with eight strikeouts.
blanks.checked: both boxes: 7.0 IP, 8 SO; SABR: 134 pitches through seven innings. Old 'the collapse came after he left' dropped as opinion.

blanks.name: Bill Buckner
blanks.fact: Batted third and played first base; his error on Mookie Wilson's grounder in the 10th let the winning run score.
blanks.checked: both boxes: Buckner 1b 3rd, E Buckner; bref pbp bottom 10th: Wilson reached on E3, Knight scores, last play; SABR: the ball skipped through Buckner's legs and Ray Knight scored.

blanks.name: Dave Henderson
blanks.fact: His homer leading off the 10th, off Rick Aguilera, put Boston ahead 4-3.
blanks.checked: both boxes: HR 10th off Aguilera, 0 on, 0 out; bref pbp: Barrett's single next at 4-3; SABR: Henderson homered in the 10th off Aguilera, 5-3 after Barrett's single. Old 'one strike from the title' dropped: not in either box.

sheets.game: 1986 World Series Game 6, 1986-10-25, Shea Stadium: Mets 6, Red Sox 5 (10 inn)

sources.role: recap for the inning by inning facts

blanks.name: Bob Ojeda
blanks.fact: Started Game 6, not Dwight Gooden, and went six innings.
blanks.checked: both boxes: Ojeda p 9th, 6.0 IP, no Gooden anywhere; SABR: Bob Ojeda started. Name fixed from Bobby to Bob: both player pages and the SABR recap bill him Bob Ojeda. Old 'lefty ex-Red Sox' dropped: not in either box.

blanks.name: Mookie Wilson
blanks.fact: Hit the grounder that went through Bill Buckner's legs, and Ray Knight scored the winning run.
blanks.checked: bref pbp bottom 10th: Wilson reached on E3 (ground ball), Knight scores, final play; almanac: E Buckner, Knight's run, 6-5 final; SABR: little roller up along first, skipped through Buckner's legs, Ray Knight scored.

blanks.name: Rafael Santana
blanks.fact: Started at short and batted eighth; Kevin Elster and Howard Johnson both took turns there later.
blanks.checked: both boxes: Santana ss 8th, Elster ss and Johnson ph,ss indented under him. Old 'most famous Game 6 ever' dropped as opinion.
